result.summary: Found 2 minor layout and spacing issues related to content overflow and padding.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off and touches the bottom navigation bar without adequate spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content view to ensure cards do not collide with the fixed bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: Horizontal scrolling elements (like category pills and restaurant cards) lack a clear visual cue indicating that there is more content off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Use a partial card preview or fade effect on the right edge to clearly signal horizontal scrollability.
